name: write-only-read-by-unreferenced-code
description: In Go a read counts only from a declaration that is live under the write-only finding's relation, reference counting, so a variable that live code writes and that only a function nothing references reads is reported as write-only. A variable live code reads is not reported. The run allows the unreferenced function's own code, because a record suppressing that finding would hold the function live, and its read with it.
